mapper.sql: select w.id, w.reader_id, w.dept_id, w.title, w.author, w.isbn, w.reason, w.status, w.reply, w.book_id, w.del_flag, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time, rd.real_name as reader_name, rd.card_no, d.dept_name, i.book_name as linked_book_name from book_wish w left join book_reader rd on w.reader_id = rd.id left join sys_dept d on w.dept_id = d.dept_id left join book_info i on w.book_id = i.id
mapper.select: where w.del_flag = '0' and w.reader_id = #{readerId} order by w.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into book_wish (reader_id, dept_id, title, author, isbn, reason, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{readerId}, #{deptId}, #{title}, #{author}, #{isbn}, #{reason}, '0', '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update book_wish set status = '1', reply = #{reply}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
update book_wish set status = '2', reply = #{reply}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
update book_wish set status = '3', book_id = #{bookId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = '1' and del_flag = '0'
update book_wish set status = '2', reply = '读者自行取消', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and reader_id = #{readerId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
